claim: CLIFER reads each ASH byte as (length = hi nybble) | (color = lo nybble) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4605.

source.verbatim: 2$	LDA	,Y+	lo nybble is color, hi nybble is length

claim: A $00 ASH byte (length and color both 0) ends the image — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4606.

source.verbatim: BEQ	1$	length & color equ 0, end of image

claim: The ash colour is the LOW nybble, isolated by ANDA #$0F — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4607.
The run length is the HIGH nybble, extracted by ANDA #$F0 (then four LSRA) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4611.
A length-nybble-0 byte ends the LINE, the next row one down (BNE 3$) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4616.

source.verbatim: BNE	3$	if length equ 0, end of line

claim: The LAST byte of a run is always one pixel (CMPA #1) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4622.

source.verbatim: CMPA	#1	last byte is always one pixel to enhance debris image

claim: That last byte keeps only its high nybble (ANDB #$F0) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:4624.
PTEASH computes the ash animation destination — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1411.

source.verbatim: PTEASH	LDD	PPOSX,U		GET DESTINATION OF ANIMATION

claim: PTEASH JMPs into CLIFER, the cliff run-length blitter — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1419.
The ptero dissolve is a 3 FRAME ANIMATION (LDA #3) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1388.
The dissolve data pointer is ASH1R — pterodactyl ashes to ashes (LDD ASH1R) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1390.

source.verbatim: LDD	ASH1R		PTERODACTYL ASHES TO ASHES

claim: Each ASH frame is drawn by BSR PTEASH — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1393.
The frame is held PCNAP 2 after the first draw — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1394.
And PCNAP 6 after the redraw — 2+6 = 8 naps per frame — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1398.

source.verbatim: PCNAP	6		while we sleep a little

claim: DEATH4 is the pterodactyl death dispatch — JOUSTRV4.SRC:2941.

source.verbatim: DEATH4	PSHS	X,U	SAVE (REG.X VICTOR, & REG.U DEAD GUY)

claim: DEATH4 shows a dead pterodactyl by dispatching PJOY to PTEKLL (LDD #PTEKLL) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:2944.
PTEKLL is the shared ptero/baiter death dance (COM PFACE,U) — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1369.
The baiter branch tests PCHASE — killed a baiter? — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1370.
A killed baiter DECrements the live-baiter count NBAIT — JOUSTRV4.SRC:1372.
The ASH1R/L run-length data begins PTERA1 with FCB $D0,$1C,$01 — JOUSTI.SRC:2781.
The image pointer table points at ASH1R, a dissolving pterodactyl (FDB ASH1R) — JOUSTI.SRC:48.
The image pointer table points at ASH1L, the mirrored dissolve (FDB ASH1L) — JOUSTI.SRC:49.
